_note: Models admitted on the new providers (openai, gemini, bedrock-converse) by their own eval gate run (docs/design/model-providers.md 5.3, 5.4). One row per model, added by a V13 PR with its baseline evals/baseline/<provider>-<model>.json. Claude providers never read this list. Fields: provider, flavor (openai only), model (a pinned id), status (supported | experimental), baseline, gated_at (YYYY-MM-DD), alias (true for a floating id; experimental only), sunset (YYYY-MM-DD, optional).
